content_sections.heading: Hardoi Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the honorarium amount or the application fee.

rows.details: Office of the District Programme Officer, Hardoi
Anganwadi Worker (Anganwadi Karyakatri), Anganwadi Helper (Anganwadi Sahayika)
Women only, permanent residents of the same Gram Sabha or urban ward
Minimum 18 years, not more than 35 years as on 01.07.2026
Urban and rural Child Development Projects of Hardoi district, Uttar Pradesh

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Office
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted by the District Programme Officer, Hardoi, whose office (Child Development Department) is in Vikas Bhawan, Hardoi. The posts are in the Child Development Projects run in the urban and rural areas of Hardoi district. The direct recruitment follows the arrangement laid down in Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17 September 2025, and a copy of the notice has been sent to the Director, Child Development Services and Nutrition (Bal Vikas Seva Evam Pushtahar), Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow.

content_sections.heading: Hardoi Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only within this period; the notice gives no separate date for submitting documents.

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: The 20 Child Development Projects of Hardoi district have 329 Anganwadi Worker and 333 Anganwadi Helper vacancies, a total of 662 posts. Kothawan has the most posts (29 Worker and 47 Helper), followed by Shahabad (21 Worker and 46 Helper); Hardoi City is the only urban project. The Gram Sabha/ward-wise details of these posts, with reservation and full eligibility details, will be pasted on the notice boards of the Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, Tehsil and Development Block offices of the district and uploaded on http://upanganwadibharti.in . The number of vacant posts may decrease or increase in special circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The same eligibility rules apply to both Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Gender: Only women candidates are eligible for the posts in this notification. Residence: The applicant must be a permanent resident of the same Gram Sabha or ward (urban) as the vacant post. Applications from another Gram Sabha or ward will not be valid. Qualification: The minimum educational qualification is Intermediate. The online merit will be prepared on the basis of the maximum educational qualification of postgraduate. Age: Minimum 18 years and not more than 35 years on the cut-off date 01.07.2026. Proof of age: Only the date of birth recorded in the High School marksheet and certificate is accepted. Income limit: Rs. 46,080.00 annual in rural areas and Rs. 56,460.00 annual in urban areas, as per Government Order No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14 September 2015 of Samaj Kalyan Anubhag-2, Uttar Pradesh Government. Income certificate: only a certificate issued online from the tehsil with a digital signature, issued at the competent level under Revenue Section-9 Government Order No. 3959/1-9-11-Raj-9 dated 30.09.2011 (as amended), that can be verified online. Caste and residence certificates: only certificates issued online from the tehsil with a digital signature that can be verified online. Widow: only a certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer or the concerned urban local body, together with a certified copy of the family register (Parivar Register). Divorced or abandoned woman: only a legal or court order. The notice does not state the age relaxation or the honorarium; the full eligibility and application details are on http://upanganwadibharti.in . Candidates should check the official notification and the Gram Sabha/ward-wise list for the eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: An online merit is prepared on the basis of educational qualification, from the minimum of Intermediate up to the maximum of postgraduate. Selection for the Anganwadi Helper and Worker posts then follows this order of preference, always within the same Gram Sabha or ward (urban area): Widow BPL candidate Divorced/abandoned BPL candidate BPL candidate Widow APL candidate Divorced/abandoned APL candidate APL candidate on the basis of merit The widow and divorced/abandoned status is accepted only on the certificates listed above.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Hardoi Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in , where the detailed form and information on the qualification and application process are available. Fill in the online application between 6 November 2026 and 26 November 2026, up to 12:00 midnight. Apply for a vacant post in your own Gram Sabha or ward only. Check every entry, especially the marks obtained and maximum marks; no offline request for correcting an error will be considered. Offline applications will not be accepted in any case. High School marksheet and certificate (date of birth) Online, digitally signed income certificate from the tehsil Online, digitally signed caste and residence certificates from the tehsil Widow certificate from the Gram Panchayat Officer or urban body and certified copy of the family register (widows) Legal or court order (divorced or abandoned women)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: If the application has any error, or any fact, figure or marks in the educational records is found false or forged, the candidature will be cancelled and the applicant will be responsible. For more information, candidates can contact the Child Development Project Office of the Development Block or the District Programme Officer (Child Development Department) office in Vikas Bhawan, Hardoi, on any office day during office hours. Child Development Project Officers have been directed to paste the Gram Sabha and reservation-wise list on tehsil and block notice boards and to inform the Gram Pradhan or ward member (Sabhasad) of the vacant posts. The notice is to be published free of charge in at least two local daily newspapers through the Information Department, Hardoi.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Hardoi Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 662 posts: 329 Anganwadi Worker (Anganwadi Karyakatri) and 333 Anganwadi Helper (Anganwadi Sahayika) posts across 20 Child Development Projects of Hardoi district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Hardoi Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: Online applications are accepted from 6 November 2026 to 26 November 2026, up to 12:00 midnight.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification is Intermediate, and the online merit is prepared on the basis of qualification up to postgraduate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Hardoi Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applicant must be at least 18 years and not more than 35 years old on 01.07.2026, as per the date of birth in the High School marksheet and certificate.

faq.question: Q5. Who can apply for Hardoi Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only women who are permanent residents of the same Gram Sabha or urban ward as the vacant post can apply; applications from other Gram Sabhas or wards are not valid.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for Hardoi Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only on http://upanganwadibharti.in within the application period; offline applications will not be accepted in any case.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through an online merit based on educational qualification, with preference in this order within the same Gram Sabha or ward: widow BPL, divorced/abandoned BPL, BPL, widow APL, divorced/abandoned APL, and APL on merit.

faq.question: Q8. What is the income limit for Hardoi Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The income limit is Rs. 46,080.00 annual in rural areas and Rs. 56,460.00 annual in urban areas, shown through an online, digitally signed income certificate from the tehsil.

faq.question: Q9. Can I correct a mistake in my application offline?
faq.answer: No, no offline application for error correction will be considered, and an application with false or forged details will be cancelled.

faq.question: Q10. Can the number of vacancies change?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says the number of vacant posts may decrease or increase in special circumstances.
